kind: diagnostic CPU profiles, not latency measurements

method.python_hash_seed: randomized because isolated mode ignores PYTHONHASHSEED

limitations: Inclusive function counts overlap and are not additive function times.
One recording per case and build cannot establish a speed difference or a regression cause.
Source attribution and unresolved-sample counts are reported separately for each recording.
Unresolved addresses and known implausible symbols are not reliable function-cost evidence.
Sampling-error counts and diagnostic artifact hashes are preserved without inferring error causes.
Private diagnostic text remains in the pinned raw artifacts and is not copied into this summary.
Missing analyses have unknown sample counts, not zero counts.
Profiles do not replace correctness, memory-safety, or compatibility testing.
